The ground truth answer to the question is "51 years." The question is asking for the age of the book at the time of an election where the Democratic party received 53.9% and 125,822 votes. The predicted answer identifies that election as the 1940 New Hampshire presidential election and calculates the age as 49 years using (1989 − 1940). However, the correct answer is 51 years, suggesting either the year of the election or the method of calculation in the predicted answer is incorrect or mismatched. Thus, the substance (i.e., the age of the book being 51 years) from the ground truth answer is not present in the predicted answer.
